analyst_view.overall: Frosinone (Massimiliano Alvini) are sixth with 20 points after back-to-back wins and come in as the in-form side. Cagliari have been stuck on 13 points under Fabio Pisacane. They are missing Mina, Nzola, Fadera and suspended Obert, which leaves Mendy as the lone striker in a 4-3-2-1. Frosinone are without striker Antonio Raimondo, and Birligea is slightly favoured over Bobcek to replace him.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, already lowered for Raimondo and Nzola being out. Frosinone's attack is flying and Cagliari have leaked goals, but Cagliari have few forwards to pick from, so the model's middle ground looks right.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.8 corners. Frosinone's 4-2-3-1 with Ghedjemis and Kvernadze out wide should earn corners, which the model already accounts for.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.3 cards, already raised a lot for referee Giovanni Ayroldi. Cagliari's winless run adds some pressure, but nothing in the news points clearly either way.

shots.text: The numbers say 33.8 shots, pushed up mainly by Frosinone's last six games. Cagliari play with a single striker (Mendy) and Frosinone are without Raimondo, so that total looks stretched.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.7 shots on target. Both sides are missing a first-choice striker (Nzola for Cagliari, Raimondo for Frosinone), which points to a slightly lower figure.
